slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: what should the plan actually optimize — for example, minimize total weekly cost (or total process hours), maximize total profit, maximize total units produced, or is any feasible plan that meets all the requirements acceptable?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked what should be optimized and included maximizing total profit as an option, directly covering the objective-function slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time or unused capacity for manufacturing, assembly, or inspection, nor about cost-proportional weights for such a secondary objective.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize total weekly profit; idle time minimization is not part of the optimization.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle-time minimization or multi-objective weighting, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit maximization and omits any idle-time objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 idle-time minimization objective was never asked about or confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the core profit-maximization objective and key constraints, but it missed the P1 secondary objective of minimizing process idle time with cost-proportional weights and silently assumed profit maximization was the only objective.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
